note: Canonical items the vision model chooses from. One id per thing a person holds up; the city files say which bin each goes in. 'hint' tells the model what the item looks like.

items.name: Cardboard box
items.hint: clean corrugated cardboard shipping or moving box

items.name: Greasy pizza box
items.hint: EMPTY pizza box with grease stains and no pizza or slice left; any pizza still visible is food_in_container

items.name: Mail / office paper / newspaper
items.hint: clean paper: letters, junk mail, envelopes, printer paper, newspaper, magazines

items.name: Cereal or cracker box
items.hint: cereal, cracker, tissue, or shoe box; not a milk or juice carton

items.name: Paper bag
